title: Profit and loss
pageHelp: Company account classifications, with the ledger rows behind every total.
coverage: Imported posted ledger entries only. This does not certify that the company books are complete.
empty: Profit and loss needs posted general-ledger entries and confirmed account classifications. Bank cash movements cannot establish profit.
partial: This is a partial report. Review excluded entries and ledger gaps before using its totals.
flowSubtitle: Revenue and other income, with expenses and net profit. Select a band or row to inspect its ledger entries.
compactAmounts: Amounts formatted compactly; click any node or band for itemized rows.

entriesSheet.noEntries: No entries found for this selection.

error: Profit and loss could not be loaded. Check the period and try again.
accountHelp: Confirm how each company account appears in profit and loss. Subledgers group the supporting detail.
saveError: The classification was not saved. Try again.
readOnly: An owner or accountant can confirm these classifications.
noAccounts: No general-ledger accounts have been imported.
sourceHelp: Subledger families group accounts; they do not certify a control-account reconciliation.
periodHelp: Use recent, all, a year (2026), quarter (2026-Q1), month (2026-03), or range (2026-01..2026-03).

exclusions.CURRENCY: Entries with missing or different currency: {{count}}
exclusions.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Entries without an eligible source document: {{count}}
exclusions.NOT_CASH_FLOW: Not a cash flow of the business (between own accounts or reversals): {{count}}

gaps.MISSING_JOURNAL_ID: Some entries have no journal ID.
gaps.UNBALANCED_JOURNAL: Some imported journals do not balance.
gaps.NO_LEDGER_EXPORT: No ledger export has been imported: this is a cash-basis report from bank lines, not an accrual income statement.

signedFlow: A reversal (a negative revenue or expense) cannot be drawn as a flow, so the report is shown as signed rows. Select a row to inspect its entries.
basisCash: Cash-basis report for {{period}}, from your bank lines
coverageCash: Categorized bank lines only, grouped by their subledger label. No ledger export has been imported, so this is not an accrual report.
emptyCash: Profit and loss needs categorized bank lines for this period, or a posted general ledger with confirmed account classifications.
accountHelpCash: Each bank-line category stands for one P&L line and one subledger in the cash-basis report. Import a ledger export to classify your own accounts.
pageHelpCash: Your bank lines by subledger label, with the lines behind every total.
flowSubtitleLoss: Revenue, other income and the net loss, with the expenses they paid. Select a band or row to inspect its ledger entries.
